description: This file contains build definitions and configuration snippets for Buffalo devices in an OpenWrt build environment. It defines device-specific variables, build steps for generating device tags, TFTP headers, and image files, as well as device metadata.

methods.name: Build/buffalo-tag
methods.description: Generates a Buffalo device tag using external binary, setting product and hardware version.

methods.name: Build/buffalo-tftp-header
methods.description: Creates a TFTP header for Airstation devices, prepending specific packet data.

methods.name: Device/buffalo_common
methods.description: Defines device-specific variables and image build instructions for Buffalo devices.
